global: This shio ramen features a clear, savory broth with halved soft-boiled eggs, nori, and chashu pork nestled among noodles. Served in a white bowl with blue trim, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture beneath the bowl.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a white interior, blue rim, and subtle gold trim, appearing smooth and glossy.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is clear, golden-brown, and glossy, with thin noodles submerged and floating ingredients visible.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk, creamy white, and smooth surface with slight sheen.
regions.seaweed: Dark green nori seaweed, slightly curled, with visible texture and glossy surface, appears as a single leaf fragment.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows browned, slightly textured surface with irregular shape and visible fat marbling.
